events.title: BECK v. UNITED STATES: Certiorari denied; Feres doctrine upheld despite criticism
events.summary: The Supreme Court denied certiorari in a case challenging the Feres doctrine, which bars servicemembers and their families from suing the federal government under the Federal Tort Claims Act for injuries incident to military service. events.title: FCC submits E-Rate program information collection for OMB review and approval
events.summary: The Federal Communications Commission submitted three forms (FCC Forms 479, 486, and 500) for a three-year OMB clearance extension under the Paperwork Reduction Act. events.summary: Dr. Vin Gupta, a leading public health physician and former chief medical officer at Amazon, warned that there is "reason to be worried" about President Trump's declining health. Gupta cited a New York Times report showing Trump has reduced his work schedule by 39% compared to his first term (1,029 engagements versus 1,688 in the first 10 months). Gupta stated "clearly something is happening" to Trump's mental capability and described visible signs of age-related cognitive decline, including slowness, fatigue, confusion, and incoherent responses.
